title: Table to Table Receives $8K Kearny Bank Grant
summary: The Table to Table food rescues mission, based in Saddle Brook, NJ, has received an $8,000 grant from Kearny Bank, though the KearnyBank Foundation.
body_markdown:
**MEALS ON THE TABLE –** The Table to Table food rescues mission, based in **Saddle Brook, NJ** , has received an $8,000 grant from Kearny Bank, though the KearnyBank Foundation. These funds will help provide nutritious meals to individuals and families throughout **northern New Jersey** who face food insecurity. More broadly, the donation will help Table to Table reduce food waste, combat hunger, and create stronger, healthier communities.


Details on supporting Table to Table are available online at[https://tabletotable.org/contact/](https://tabletotable.org/contact/)


**About Kearny Bank**


Combining the finest traditions of community banking with the industry’s latest, most effective financial products and services, Kearny Bank provides business and personal clients with the tools for success. Established back in 1884, and now operating from corporate offices in Fairfield, NJ, Kearny Bank’s footprint covers most of New Jersey, along with Brooklyn and Staten Island. Additional information is available at[kearnybank.com](https://www.kearnybank.com/) or by visiting Kearny Bank’s social media channels:[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kearnybank) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kearny_bank/) ,[X](https://twitter.com/KearnyBank) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/1319584) and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwieXSwL9OscxNRUhzWwQyQ) .
